description: 🆕 One block on Base — height, hash, parent, timestamp and age in seconds, transaction count, gas used against the limit, and the base fee in gwei. Takes a block number, a 0x… block hash, or latest / finalized / safe / earliest. A block that isn't mined yet answers found:false with the reason rather than an error. Raw chain data, no interpretation.

block.description: Block number, hash, or tag (default latest)

name: base_block

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the underlying reads were taken.

data.description: The result payload. Shape is service-specific; every field is documented in the tool description.

title: Base Block
